objective: To make the cross dock master of AP POLE equal to NSP by an RPA process on the AP POLE web screens (decided 17-Nov, replaces the SFTP interface file): part level on WLM9Q890 Cross Dock Kanban Part Master, destination level on WLM9Q860 Export Customer Cross Dock Master.

Source data: the Export Excel files of XD01, downloaded by the bot itself after [Sync] (decided 17-Nov): Kanban Crossdock Master (Status, Part Name, Pcs/Case, Max Case/Day), Export Crossdock Master of the ongoing period (Destination Code, Dest Case/Day, Last Sync Date); only the parts with Sync Status Waiting.

Part level: a part that became Active is added (or edited when AP POLE still has it), an Active part with a new Pcs/Case or Max Case/Day is edited, a part that went Active -> Inactive is deleted. Destination level: destinations are added, deleted or edited so that AP POLE has the same Buyer-PD and Max Shipping Box Qty as NSP.
Step by step guide with the AP POLE screens: deliverables/user_guide/Crossdock_User_Guide_AP_POLE.xlsx.

RPA: read the parts not synced yet

Status per part, GTOPAS_SYNC_DT / APPOLE_SYNC_DT, overall Sync Status, history

steps: [Sync] on XD01 sets the parts to Waiting (SYNC_STATUS = '3', SYNC_STATUS = '3' for 'GTOPAS' and 'APPOLE') and starts the RPA bot. Write LOG1. The whole run is inside one try-catch.

steps.text: The bot logs in to NSP and downloads the XD01 Export Excel: Export Crossdock Master (ongoing period, Sync Status = Waiting) and Kanban Crossdock Master; it reads them. It adds the work sheet AP POLE Compare to the file (part / Buyer-PD, NSP value, AP POLE value, Action Add / Edit / Delete / Keep, Result, AP POLE message).
children: Parts to process = Sync Status No Sync / Waiting (not synced since the last change). Part level from Kanban Crossdock Master (Status, Part Name, Pcs/Case, Max Case/Day); destination level from Export Crossdock Master (Destination Code, Dest Case/Day); parts to delete = Kanban Crossdock Master rows with Status Inactive (Waiting).

steps.text: AP POLE menu Master Maintenance > Cross Dock Kanban Part Master (WLM9Q890): Effective From = first day, To = last day of the month, Part No. = part of the source, [Search].
Part level (4.2): add, edit or delete the part on WLM9Q890.
children: Add / Edit: Shipping Box Qty = PCS_CASE, Max Shipping Box Qty = MAX_CASE_DAY, [Save]. Delete: tick the part, [Delete].

steps.text: Destination level (4.3): tick the part, [Maintain Cross Dock] (opens WLM9Q860), compare the Buyer-PD rows with the NSP destinations and add, delete or edit them; [Back].
children: Add: Buyer-PD = DEST_CODE (5-2 format), Order Type **, Transport Code 2, Max Shipping Box Qty = Dest Case/Day.
Total Shipping Allocated may not be more than Max Shipping Box Qty of the part: delete the destinations not in NSP before adding.

steps.text: Try-catch: any error (login, screen not available, timeout, AP POLE error message, source file not readable) stops the bot at once.
children: The whole run is Failed (one fails, all fail): LOG4 with the step, part and destination. Changes made before the error stay in AP POLE (no rollback on the screen); the next run compares again and completes the rest.

steps.text: Set the result of every Waiting part for 'APPOLE' in TB_M_PART_CANDIDATE and the overall Sync Status:
children: No error: SYNC_STATUS = '1', send time and GTOPAS_SYNC_DT / APPOLE_SYNC_DT = now, e-mail message = 'part <added / edited / deleted>, dest added <n>, deleted <n>, edited <n>'. Error: SYNC_STATUS = '2', send time = now, GTOPAS_SYNC_DT / APPOLE_SYNC_DT not changed.
TB_M_PART_CANDIDATE: CHANGED_DT changed since step 2 -> '0' (No Sync); else 'GTOPAS' and 'APPOLE' both '1' -> '1' (Success), one '2' -> '2' (Failed), one still '3' -> stays '3'.
Insert TB_H_PART_CANDIDATE: event SYNC, source RPA, FIELD_NAME SYNC_STATUS, REMARK = 'APPOLE: ' + e-mail message.

steps: Write LOG2 with the counts (parts added / edited / deleted, destinations added / deleted / edited) and the status. Exit.

items: The Procurement team maintains the Kanban Crossdock Master and the D/S team the Export Crossdock Master on XD01. Every change of a value sent to GTOPAS / AP POLE sets the part to No Sync (Sync Status rule of XD01, 17-Nov).
The D/S team clicks [Sync] when the changes are complete; that is the only manual step. The RPA bot downloads the Excel, fills the work sheet and makes AP POLE equal to NSP (XD07) and GTOPAS (XD06).
RPA on the AP POLE web screens (decided 17-Nov): the SFTP interface file is no longer used. Part level on WLM9Q890, destination level on WLM9Q860 ([Maintain Cross Dock] of the ticked part).

Source data: the XD01 Export Excel files (Kanban Crossdock Master, Export Crossdock Master), downloaded by the bot after [Sync]; parts with Sync Status Waiting. Steps with the screens: deliverables/user_guide/Crossdock_User_Guide_AP_POLE.xlsx.

items: The whole bot run is in one try-catch. Any error stops the run: login failed, screen not available, timeout, an AP POLE error message, source file not readable.
One fails, all fail: every Waiting part gets 'APPOLE' SYNC_STATUS = '2' (Failed) and the overall Sync Status Failed; GTOPAS_SYNC_DT / APPOLE_SYNC_DT is not changed. The D/S team clicks [Sync] again.
Changes made before the error stay in AP POLE (no rollback on the screen). The next run compares again and completes the rest.
On Success: SYNC_STATUS = '1', send time and GTOPAS_SYNC_DT / APPOLE_SYNC_DT = date-time of the result (shown as Last Sync on XD01).

AP POLE also accepts an upload: Report Type LM9Q900 - Upload Kanban Part Master (columns Effective Month, Effective Year, Operator ID, Part No., Part Name, Shipping Box Qty, Max Shipping Box Qty, Max Allowance Qty, ...) and LM9Q870 - Upload Export Customer Cross Dock Master (columns Effective Month, Effective Year, Part No., Buyer-PD, Order Type, Transport Code, Max Shipping Box (RCS), ...).
Whether the bot uses the screens (4.2 / 4.3) or the upload is to be confirmed (refer 4.6).
The cloud flow of the RPA sends one email per run of XD07 (AP POLE), so the user knows the result without opening NSP.
One email per target: XD06 (GTOPAS) and XD07 (AP POLE) run as separate bots, so a [Sync] gives two emails.
One email per run: the retries of the same run do not send an email; only the final result does.

LOG6 is written when the email is sent; when sending fails, the run result stays and the RPA PIC sees it in the Power Automate run history.

No response from the RPA (20-Nov): NSP does not receive the result of XD06 / XD07. [Sync] sets the parts to Sent (SYNC_STATUS '3', SYNC_STATUS '3', send time and GTOPAS_SYNC_DT / APPOLE_SYNC_DT = send time); Success / Failed are not kept in NSP. The result comes by the notification e-mail of Power Automate (SUCCESS / FAILED with the work file). When the e-mail says FAILED, D/S clicks [Re-send last Sync].

The bot writes nothing back to NSP: the steps "set the result in TB_M_PART_CANDIDATE", "overall Sync Status" and "history SYNC" of the function flow and the data edit mapping of these tables are not used. NSP writes them when it sends ([Sync] on XD01 or the Period Rollover of XD05).
Try-catch: an error stops the run and the e-mail is FAILED (E2 / E3). Rows already changed on the target screen stay; [Re-send last Sync] compares again and completes them.

Parts of the run: NSP passes the send time (run ID) when it starts the flow; the bot takes the rows with Sync Status Sent and Last Sent Date = that send time from the downloaded Export Excel (parts sent earlier are not processed again).
Evidence of a run: the e-mail and the work file (sheet Compare) with action, result and message per row.

TB_R_CROSSDOCK_IF_RESULT is removed. NSP writes the send on TB_M_PART_CANDIDATE before the bot starts: SYNC_STATUS 3 Sent, APPOLE_SYNC_DT = send time, SYNC_RUN_ID = run ID; the bot gets the run ID and the send time when the flow starts.
Parts of the run = rows with SYNC_RUN_ID = run ID (in the Export Excel: Last Sent AP POLE = send time).

The bot writes nothing to NSP; the result is the notification e-mail. Log (existing table, one record per send run, 20-Nov): BATCH_ID XD06_RPA_GTOPAS / XD07_RPA_APPOLE, RUN_ID, send time, sent by (user of [Sync] / [Re-send last Sync] or the Period Rollover), number of parts, period(s). [Re-send last Sync] repeats the targets of the last run.

func_desc.text: 4.8 Period, Order Type and Order of the Screens (19-Nov)

items: Effective Month / Year of WLM9Q890 and WLM9Q860 = the period of the NSP data: MM and YYYY (e.g. 202612 -> 12 / 2026).
One [Sync] sends the Current period first, then the Next period. The Next period is sent on day D after XD05; on day 1 nothing new is sent.
Order Type of a Buyer PD row = ORDER_TYPE of the Export Crossdock Master row ('**', 'C', '9', 'V'); key in AP POLE: Buyer PD + Order Type.

Max Case/Day of the period goes down: 1. WLM9Q860 Delete / Edit the Buyer PD rows (Total Shipping Allocated <= new max), 2. WLM9Q890 Edit Max Shipping Box Qty. Goes up or stays: 1. WLM9Q890 Add / Edit the part, 2. WLM9Q860 Delete, Edit, then Add.
Simulation: deliverables/function_list_v2/simulation/XD07_Simulation_AP_POLE_Period.xlsx.

tables.name: TB_M_PART_CANDIDATE
tables.description: Kanban Crossdock Master: one record per part and calculation period (19-Nov; before: one record per part).
columns: Calculation period YYYYMM (19-Nov): one row per part and period. Current: screen / upload; Next: made by XD05 on day D (view only until day 1); Past: view only
Minimum MAD (mandatory); reference compared with the MAD result of the calculation
Effective start date; required while the part is Candidate
0 = No Sync, 3 = Sent (20-Nov: 1 Success / 2 Failed not used, no response from the RPA)
Date-time of the last send of the part (this period) to GTOPAS: [Sync], [Re-send last Sync] or the Period Rollover (XD05 process 3); shown as Last Sent GTOPAS
Date-time of the last send of the part (this period) to AP POLE: [Sync] or [Re-send last Sync]; shown as Last Sent AP POLE. XD07 takes the parts whose APPOLE_SYNC_DT = send time of its run
Run ID (YYYYMMDDHHMMSS) of the last send; [Re-send last Sync] sends the rows of the last run ID again
Upload that last changed the record
User who last changed the record

tables.name: TB_M_PART_CANDIDATE_DEST
tables.description: Export Crossdock Master: one record per part, calculation period, destination and order type.
columns: Calculation period, YYYYMM e.g. 202609; displayed as Sep 2026
Destination code (buyer code + PD code, 7 digits); exists in TB_M_H0125_DESTINATION (Destination Master)
Order Type of the row (system master: '**', 'C', '9', 'V'; default '**'). One row per part, period, destination and order type (19-Nov)
User who last changed the record

tables.name: TB_H_PART_CANDIDATE
tables.description: History of every change of a crossdock part (Add / Edit by screen or upload, mapping changes, Sync results, status changes and mappings made by the calculation batches). Read by the History setting modal of Kanban Crossdock Master (index PART_NO, CREATED_DT). No retention limit: the history is kept (no housekeeping job, decided 30-Oct).
columns: Calculation period YYYYMM of the changed row (every event; Kanban and Export Crossdock Master are per period, 20-Nov)
SCREEN / UPLOAD / BATCH (SYNC: SCREEN for [Sync] / [Re-send last Sync], BATCH for the Period Rollover)
Upload of the change (Log); NULL when not from an upload
Destination code (7 digits) for MAPPING; NULL for other events
Order Type of the destination row for MAPPING (with DEST_CODE); NULL for other events (20-Nov)
Changed field: PCS_CASE, MAX_CASE_DAY, MIN_MAD, PART_STATUS, EFFECTIVE_START_DATE, CASE_DAY, SYNC_STATUS
Value before the change; NULL for ADD or an added destination
Value after the change; NULL for a removed destination
Free text; SYNC: target(s) + run ID, e.g. 'GTOPAS, APPOLE: 20261127100000'
User who made the change (IF batch user ID for SYNC, batch user ID for BATCH)
Date and time of the change
